convention: Retain original state and support masks; each information-losing map specifies its kernel/fibre. No global arithmetic occupancy assumed.

maps.inverse_or_fibre: u=pa^2/(Ry-pa), Q=N/R; retain p,R,M and ordered denominators

maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Ordinary coefficient algebra isomorphism, not a global sparse-semiring inverse.
